scenes.headline: How a compiler can tell the check really happened
scenes.sub: Authorization as a proof value, checked at compile time.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Waffle! Most authorization bugs are a correct check that never reached the line that needed it. Here is how to make the compiler notice.

scenes.text: A sensitive function demands a proof about its exact arguments, and only the module that ran the check can mint one.
scenes.mark: only the module that ran the check can mint one
scenes.say: The idea: a sensitive function demands a proof about its exact arguments, and only the module that ran the check can mint one.

left.title: Boolean check
items: Nothing ties it to the write
left.say: Usually a check returns a boolean. Nothing ties that bit to the write, so a refactor can drop it.

right.title: Proof value
right.say: Here the check returns a proof about this user and this project, and the write will not compile without it.

steps.say: A request brings a user and a project id. The name function gives each a fresh type, valid only inside its callback.
A trusted module runs the role check and returns an admin proof about exactly those names.
Another checks the billing plan, and proves something about the project.
The sensitive function demands both. A proof about another project carries another name, and will not match.

scenes.title: What TypeScript needs to make it hold

items.say: TypeScript compares by structure, so the name sits in an invariant slot it cannot ignore.
A generic callback keeps each name inside its request.
And since anyone can write a type assertion, a lint rule bans forged proofs.

It hands you the value under a name you cannot write down.

scenes.label: Ways to call setPasswordProtection that compile
scenes.say: I type checked sixty ways to make one sensitive call. Three compile: the honest one, and two forgeries only the lint rules catch.

scenes.text: A compiler can only check what the code carries. gdp-ts makes the authorization check something the code carries.
scenes.say: The compiler can only check what the code carries. Now the check is something it carries.

recap: The linter closes the cast loophole
scenes.say: Checks return proofs. Only trusted modules mint them. And lint rules close the cast loophole.
